message: Update version to 0.10.0.
Update 1 outdated snapshot.
Fetch 10 star DFC difficulty data and add a filtering option for it.
Add to advanced search filtering by playdata category.
Set up advanced search which allows filtering by difficulty, stars, BPM and more.
Update song_mapping.
Expand ESE index to include additional metadata.
Update version to 0.9.8.
Allow more flexibility in playdata display. Move the dropdown to settings page.
Update song mapping format. Incorporate DonderHelper data for more localized titles.
Simplify some UI label text.
Update version to 0.9.7.
Slightly reduce inner border width multiplier for selected notes.
Remove the inner (white) border from drumroll notes.
Slightly reduce bar border line width.
Update Vite config to allow app hot reloading when the renderer package changes.
Improve vertical bar line rendering by determining the line color beforehand and drawing a single line across bar top and body.
Apply pixel snapping more consistently across renderer implementation.
Update version to 0.9.6.
Slight adjustments to default layout ratios.
Add a layout parameter for large note inner border width.
Add a playground for renderer parameters to the renderer example package. Include the renderer example content in the app build process.
Slight adjustments in default note sizes and line widths.
Update version to 0.9.5.
Apply a few anti aliasing optimizations to renderer.
Slightly adjust note sizes and border widths.
Support overriding layout ratios in renderer public API.
Update border drawing logic so that the line width ratios map exactly to the visible width, without overlapping or gaps between the note circles or borders.
Separate more clearly public and private API in the renderer package. Update app to use package dependency.
Refactor renderer.ts into smaller components.
Update version to 0.9.4.
Prioritize branching indicator (yellow line) over BPM/HS change indicator (grey line) when both happen at the same time.
Update branching stats panel width and indicate unreachable expert/master branches.
Automatically hide unreachable branches on the rendered chart. Improve connection between unbranched bars and single branch bars.
Update outdated snapshots.
Fix branch condition parsing with unpaired BRANCHSTART/BRANCHEND commands.
Run formatter.
Fix incorrect notes parsing by EXAM commands.
Add basic support for the NEXTSONG command in Dan charts.
Update version to 0.9.3.
Add a label to the playdata display dropdown, add localization, and move the share chart button below the list.
Add UI tests for playdata display in chart list.
Slight improvement in chart list playdata styling.
Add a few display modes to show playdata along with the chart list.
Make sure chart list labels are aligned regardless of the playdata strip status.
Update version as 0.9.2.
Update chart list to use crown status from playdata for the strip color.
Update playdata importer to identify songs by ID instead of title. Remove the manual resolution UI.
Extend fumen-database parsing to include song ID, crown and score rank.
Store playdata with song ID instead of titles from Fumen Database. Add versioning to the stored playdata. Fix an issue where chart list UI for playdata can be outdated.
Improve title resolution during playdata import.
Update playdata importer to allow users to manually address some unmatched entires where a fuzzy match is available.
Update README with a high level version history.
Update version as 0.9.1.
Display chart list items with titles instead of full path where appropriate. Add a button to export play data as JSON.
Unify the behavior of button click feedback by adding a reusable component.
Move dev mode toggle to the end of settings page.
Display a strip among chart list items to indicate playdata status.
Update page URL when rendered ESE chart changes.
Allow saving default view options and triggerig auto annotation on chart load.
Fix a few broken tests.
Update version to 0.9.0.
Support searching by CN/KR title and by artist.
Update playdata import flow to work around iOS limitations. Make modal pages respect safe areas.
Support exporting playdata to taiko-rating-analyzer format.
Support parsing and importing of fumen-database playdata through a bookmarklet.
Create a local persistent user profile and use it to store tester mode status.
Add a settings modal page, move the developer mode toggle there.
Update version to 0.8.6.
Update dev server to use port 8082.
Add basic branch stats display.
Delay the display of loading text until 1s since page load.
Use port 8081 for playwright tests to avoid conflict with dev/start.
Use heroicon for the horizontal controls toggle.
Update README.
Reduce code duplication in renderer implementation.
Fix broken test cases.
Update version to 0.8.5.
Add missing attribution text under renderChart.
Fix file sharing web fallback.
Move the save image button and full screen button to a shared chart options footer.
Disable PWA service worker in development mode.
Remove canvas container padding and use renderer insets instead. Fix minor issues regarding insets in the renderer.
Add basic partial rendering functionality. Add toggle to render only the selected notes.
Run formatter.
Add limited horizontal compression to chart title if too long.
Update version to 0.8.4.
Fix PWA offline support on iOS: use absolute paths, inline Workbox runtime, and add conditional debug info.
Update outdated test snapshots.
Fix linking of the Neutralino runtime library which was broken since the migration to vite.
Add app version and platform label to about modal.
Add a minimal attribution label to the end of rendered chart.
Run formatter.
Update line wrapping behavior to avoid horizontal scroll in chart list.
Add a minimal loading screen until UI initialization completes.
Update version to 0.8.3.
Update icon for the "exit fullscreen" button.
Attempt to fix occasional unresponsive scrolling of fullscreen chart.
Improve chart rendering DPR fallback for large render sizes.
Update version to 0.8.2.
